file.notApplied: The file on disk is not applied; its last good version is in use

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Who may be reached, on which channel, for what, as of now. Every answer counts with the text version it was given for.
overview.perDayDetail: Every channel and purpose, the last 30 days
overview.bannerDetail: Answers on the banner, the last 30 days
overview.noBannerDetail: They show once a site loads its script and visitors answer.
overview.nothingDetail: Answers from the banner, the preference page, forms, the API and İYS show here.

people.title: People
people.description: Each person's latest answer for every purpose and channel, and how they got there. A person may be reached only while that answer is yes.
people.browserOnly: A visitor known by their browser
people.noneDetail: People are added when they answer the banner, a form, the preference page or the API, or when İYS reports them.
people.pick: Pick a person to see their record

person.gone: This person is no longer in the record.
person.latest: Latest answer by purpose and channel
person.conflict: İYS and this record disagree on {{purpose}} by {{channel}}
person.conflictDetail: Here: {{local}}, {{localAt}}. In İYS: {{iys}}, {{iysAt}}. Both are kept; {{counts}} is later and counts.
person.kept: The history is kept as given. Nobody can edit or remove an entry; a new answer is added on top.
person.exported: The record was exported as JSON, with every answer, its version and its source.

record.title: Record an answer
record.description: For an answer given by phone, in a store or by letter. It is added to the history with your name; nothing earlier is changed.
record.howPlaceholder: Asked not to be called, on a support call
record.toIys: It is sent to İYS within minutes.

erase.title: Erase this person
erase.description: For a request under KVKK or GDPR. Their identifiers and history are removed and cannot be brought back. The erasure is logged with your name and the reason, without them. İYS is told no for every channel they had agreed to.
erase.reasonPlaceholder: The request's reference, such as KVKK-2026-114
erase.done: Erased. The erasure is in the log.

purposes.title: Purposes
purposes.description: What people are asked to agree to, and every version of its text. Purposes and their texts are set in consent.yaml; a change of wording is a new version.
purposes.textDetail: As people saw it on the banner, in forms and on the preference page.
purposes.versionDetail: v{{version}} in use from {{from}}. {{count}} people's latest yes was given to this text, and stays tied to it.
purposes.required: The site cannot work without it; never asked
purposes.noSites: No site shows the banner yet; add one under sites: in the file.

iys.description: Consents and refusals for commercial messages by email, SMS and call go to İYS and come back from it. When the two disagree, the later answer wins and both are kept.
iys.setDetail: Add your İYS account and brand to the file. The API user and its password are read from the environment variables the file names.
iys.lastError: The last sync failed; it is tried again in a few minutes
iys.logEmpty: Nothing has gone to İYS or come from it yet.
iys.failedDetail: {{status}} for {{recipient}} ({{type}}), given {{at}}. Fix the cause, then send it again.
iys.rule: A consent given on a form or the preference page must reach İYS within 3 business days; Consent sends it within minutes. Refusals from İYS count as soon as they arrive.

sites.title: Banner and page
sites.description: A cookie banner and a preference page, from one script tag. The texts are the current versions of the purposes in consent.yaml.
sites.noneDetail: Add a site under sites: in consent.yaml to give it a banner.
sites.bannerIntro: Choose what this site may store in your browser and measure. You can change it at any time.
sites.equal: Reject all is as easy to reach as Accept all. Nothing is measured before an answer.
sites.pageIntro: A preference link names the person, so the page shows their messages by channel too. A change counts from now and is kept in their record.
sites.pageNote: A preview: nothing is recorded here.
sites.installDetail: One tag in the page's head; the banner and the preference panel come with it.
sites.asksAgainValue: When a text's new version asks again

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Messages, Analytics, Forms and Audience ask before they act. The answer is yes only while the person's latest answer for that purpose and channel is yes.

why.renew: Yes to v{{version}}, but the text asks again

checks.noneDetail: The latest checks are kept in memory only, for this page.
checks.note: Only the answer and its reason leave Consent. A product that cannot reach Consent does not send; it waits and asks again.

setup.title: Setup
setup.description: Purposes and sites are set in a file; the banner is one script tag; your products ask the API.
setup.step1Detail: In {{path}}. A version's text never changes once applied: a new wording is a new version. The file is read again within a minute.
setup.step2: 2. Add the script to the site
setup.step2Detail: The banner asks until the visitor answers; data-openasy-preferences on any link opens the panel again.
setup.step3: 3. Ask before you reach someone, and record what they agree to
setup.step3Detail: With an API token: viewer to ask, editor to record.
setup.step4: 4. Put a preference link in your messages
setup.step4Detail: A signed link to the preference page, where the person changes their messages by channel.

settings.askAnAdmin: Ask an admin of this Consent for access.
settings.accountDetail: Your profile, password, two-step verification and where you are signed in.
settings.membersDetail: Who can sign in to Consent, and with which role. Viewers see every record and check; editors also record answers and make preference links; admins also erase people, sync İYS, and manage members and tokens.
settings.signinDetail: Identity providers people can sign in with, such as OpenAsy Identity, Keycloak or Microsoft Entra ID, and which of their groups give which role.
settings.tokensDetail: For the products and scripts that ask and record. Each token has one role and an expiry; the secret is shown once.
